title: A stated preference is applied in a later chat

turns.prompt: A preference for all our future chats: whenever I ask you to summarise something, answer with exactly three bullet points, each starting with the • character, and nothing else.

Summarise this: The Cedar Hollow community garden opens at 7:00 and closes at dusk. Odd-numbered plots water on Monday, Wednesday and Friday; even-numbered plots on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Sunday is a shared workday from 9:00 to 11:00 with compost turning and path mulching. Garlic planting is on 1 November, leaf-mould day on 15 November, and the season closes on 30 November when the water is turned off.
